text:
```yaml
name: PR Preview Deployment

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'website/**'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

env:
  NODE_VERSION: '20'

jobs:
  build-and-preview:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: website/package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: website
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build website
        working-directory: website
        run: npm run build

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: website-preview
          path: website/dist
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Deploy to Cloudflare Pages
        id: deploy
        if: ${{ env.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN != '' && env.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID != '' }}
        uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3
        with:
          apiToken: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          accountId: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          command: pages deploy website/dist --project-name=razorconsole-website --branch=pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}

      - name: Post PR Comment
        uses: marocchino/sticky-pull-request-comment@v2
        with:
          header: preview-deployment
          message: |
            ## 🚀 Preview Deployment
            
            ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.deployment-url != '' && format('✅ **Live Preview**: [View Site]({0})', steps.deploy.outputs.deployment-url) || '⬇️ **Artifact Download**: The built site has been uploaded as an artifact.' }}
            
            ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.deployment-url == '' && 'To download the preview artifact, click on the "Artifacts" tab above, download `website-preview`, and unzip it.' || '' }}
            
            ---
            *Generated by PR Preview Workflow*
```
